notes: S2-FIX6 (decision 2026-11-16 #13; §5.3 governing window; review A high 1 w1, review B high-2): two declarations of one device key, D1 at T0 with valid_until T1 and D2 at T2 without a window, both cosigned by their owner; a note by the device key at T3. D1 also carries a cosignature by an undeclared key (unverifiable E_KEY_UNKNOWN), so it is not semantically valid and governs no window: D2 governs, D2 and the note are valid (the note with N_KEY_TOFU). Taking the window from D1 would make both E_KEY_EXPIRED.
